items.note: States the result: (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored for arbitrary initial values. It says 'three forward invocations', but the paper uses forward, then the inverse schedule from Y to X, then forward (731-733, 761-763). Neighbour rules, coefficients, h, N and the wire counts are absent.

Gives the mechanism (a common frame per gate commutes with the pointwise gate) and the endpoint operator. It omits the sign epsilon_w and the routing rho in epsilon_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1}, and does not write D_out S D_in^{-1}.

Has nested nondegenerate labels from triple indicators, loss confined to central edges, sum |Delta dim| = Wm-2N+2L and L<N/2. It omits the ambient space F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, that only the time-3-to-4 central edges decrease and each loses h, L=Ich, and the ratios 100/539 and 101/539.

Has endpoint differences I_m, s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m and the resulting shear H<-H+D on every row. It says projections P_U are assigned to the labels and omits the negative source matrix -P_{U_a} on X_a, which the endpoint identity needs and which produces the rank-one source exceptions (1117-1118, 1162-1170).

Has one kernel aI+bX_v per orthonormal residual vector, s_c children and C^{tensor e} on every role. It omits the kernel inverses, the value s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c<W_c m, the definition of C_U, and the diagonal corrections and undoing of the exchange.

Has L<N/2, s_b<W_b m and s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}. The deficits eta_b and eta_c, the bound eta>20*2^{-50} with log m<20 that justifies tau, and the complex bound s_c/W_c<m^sigma are absent; S2 only says s/W<m.
The elementary operations are correctly listed at O(V). S1.2 drops the condition that the offset can be prepared in b^{O(1)} time, although its own quote contains it.

Correctly states the E_1 Pi E_2 factorization with a ones and the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V). These are infer steps; the elimination and the three-update interchange trick are not shown.

Follows the paper's route: W role streams, each edge as a shear by recursive interchanges, H<-H+D on every row, the three updates, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) and the fixed-tape stack schedule. The statement says 'enough rows' where the paper requires a row-field length divisible by W^k.
The statement matches lem:chunk-swap. S1.5 sketches the reduction (high digits as rows, width in base m) but omits padding rows to a multiple of W^k and padding binary ranges to radix q.

Has s_c children on e/m axes and the identity H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D. It omits the conjugation by P_M that moves residual directions to coordinate slots, and the forward-child form of inverse kernels; binary basis changes appear only in S2's method and S2.4.

Has the mechanism (whole-chunk cyclic shifts, a third chunk restored, sorted repair of an exceptional set) and the O(V(L^tau+1)) cost. It omits delta_bad and the extra terms of the general bound, which reduces to O(V(L^tau+1)) only in the parameter family.
States the recurrence exactly and the O(d^{lambda'}) result. The leaf case e<d^beta, the bound K<=e^{c/beta}, the base-m pieces and the conditions on lambda' are absent.

Follows the paper's proof: the phase kernel, s_c children of volume V/W, packed basis changes, the recurrence, conversion by H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D, O(d^{C_1})=o(p) guard bits, and one truncation with error below sqrt2 2^{-p}.

Has omega_t=y^{2r/t}, contractions, signed-shift twiddles, the common-offset layout and the cost O(Tp[dK+pK^{tau-1}+l d^{lambda'}]). It omits F_t^+F_t^-=t^{-1}I, the bit-reversal B, the exact counterparts LBF^- and F^+B^{-1}L^{-1}, and the error sqrt2 l 2^{-p}.
Correct: signed Kronecker packing at B_0=2^{4p} with the established multiplier, in O(rp log(rp)).

Correct statement with the right error bound, and the method follows the paper (forward transforms, pointwise products in retained order, opposite transform). It omits the exact scaling by M, the normalization identity, and the fact that LB permutes whole records so the retained order commutes with the pointwise product.

Has P_sF_s=2^{2 alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA with both permutations left in the formula, and the axis-by-axis form. It omits the condition theta=t/s-1>p/alpha^4, the error and cost of the approximations, and the tensor constants gamma and R,Q.
Has the Bluestein form of QF_t and the cancellation (RF^+)[(RFu)(RFv)]=(u*v)/S^2. The chirp a is never defined and the 1/T normalization of the convolution is missing.

Has b, p=6b, d=floor(b^epsilon), t_i in {r/2,r}, and distinct odd primes just below t_i. It gives T as 'approximately n/b' (the paper takes T in [4n/b,8n/b)) and omits K, eta=1/(4d), the prime window, alpha and gamma, and the fixed exponents except kappa.
Has Phi: x -> prod x_i^{mu_i}, the preservation of cyclic convolution and the triangular controlled shifts. It does not define mu_i=P_i^{-1} mod s_i, give the triangular formula, or state the cost.
Correct: x_d -> zeta y with zeta=e^{pi i/r} identifies cyclic convolution on the last axis with negacyclic convolution in R_r.

The source transform as resampling, chirp and resampling, and the overall steps, are right. S3.10 gives the scalings as 'S and 2^{2b+4}', but the paper scales by S and then by 2^{2b+4}S. It puts rounding after undoing Phi and omits the input scaling 2^{-b-2}.
Gives only the conclusion: error below 1/2, so rounding and carries are exact (S3.6 gives c_j<2^{3b}). The error chain (E_s, E_w, the bound 448b 2^{-3b/4}, gamma<=b/4) is absent.

Follows the route: seven normalized costs, margins g_1..g_7, min g_2=2^{-181}=2kappa, setup o(Tp), O(Tp p^{1-kappa}), and schoolbook below a cutoff. It never lists the normalized costs (dK, pK^{tau-1}, l d^{lambda'}, ...) or the margin formulas such as g_2=epsilon c(1-tau).
Only S0's relies-on link names an optimality-conjecture. No step states the eventual lower bound or that liminf T_A(n)/(n lg n)=0 refutes it.

errors.says: Three forward invocations of a gather/scatter/side-injection schedule send (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a).
errors.paper: Stage 1 is a forward invocation from X to Y, stage 2 is the inverse schedule from Y to X (effecting X<-X-Y), and stage 3 is forward from X to Y, giving (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x). Three forward invocations X->Y would give y+3x.

errors.says: Projection matrices P_U assigned to the labels give endpoint differences I_m.
errors.paper: Gates and sinks get P_U, but source X_a gets -P_{U_a} and other sources get zero; the negative source projection is essential to the endpoint identity P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m and gives the N rank-one exceptions.

errors.says: Radix-2^b digit convolution on S distinct prime axes.
errors.paper: There are d axes of pairwise coprime prime lengths s_1,...,s_d, and S=prod s_i is their product, the convolution length.

errors.says: ...applies the opposite transform, scales by S and 2^{2b+4}, undoes Phi, rounds and propagates carries.
errors.paper: Step 4 multiplies by S; step 5 multiplies by 2^{2b+4}S (so 2^{2b+4}S^2 in total) and rounds to integers before Phi^{-1} is applied.

errors.says: power-of-two axis lengths with product T approximately n/b
errors.paper: T is the power of two in [4n/b,8n/b), a factor 4 to 8 above n/b.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the bound: fast interchange from the rank-saving bit network (S1), the simultaneous butterfly layer from the complex network (S2), the CRT, resampling, chirp and synthetic-convolution reduction (S3), and the cost table with min margin 2kappa (S4). It thins out at the network itself (S1.3.1-S1.3.4 are infer steps without h, N, m, the L/N ratios, the negative source projection or the rank-equals-dimension argument, and without the deficit computation that fixes tau=1-2^{-50}). The reduction (S3) and the cost table (S4.1) are also listed rather than computed.

steps.note: The exchange (X_a,Y_a) to (-Y_a,X_a) with restored scratch wires is stated. h=100, the triple indexing, N and m=h^3 are absent, and the stage composition is misstated as three forward invocations.
One invertible frame per gate commutes with pointwise gates, so a route applies only its endpoint operator. S1.3's method has the labels price each edge's frame change. The sign epsilon_w is omitted.
Nested nondegenerate labels and loss on central edges are stated. The ambient F^{tensor 3} of dimension m, the restriction to time 3 to 4, and the loss h per wire are missing.
Only that projections 'price each edge'. Neither rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U nor the N rank-one source exceptions appears.
Both sum |Delta dim|=Wm-2N+2L and s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b are stated. L=Ich is not written, though L is described as the central-edge loss.
L<N/2 and s_b<W_b m are asserted, but the values 100/539 and 101/539 and the deficit N-2L>0 are not given.
Endpoint differences I_m, hence the shear H<-H+D on every row, scratch rows included. The -P_{U_a} source matrix that makes the identity hold is not mentioned.
E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones, exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and edges applied as shears by recursive interchanges of width e/m.
Has W role streams (volume V/W), F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50}, and F_k=O(e^tau). The justification of tau (eta>20*2^{-50}, log m<20) is missing.

central.summary: The back half of the chain is reconstructed: frames, the budget formulas, the endpoint identity, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The front half, which explains why s<Wm, is only gestured at: the h=100 triple network with N and m, the labels' loss of h on time-3-to-4 central edges, rank equals dimension change with N rank-one source exceptions, and the ratios L/N=100/539 and 101/539 are all missing. The plan asserts the saving rather than reconstructing it.
